build_share_requests_approved_review_req.name: build_share_requests_approved_review_required
build_share_requests_approved_review_req.value: "build_share_requests"."status" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("build_share_requests"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "build_share_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

build_versions_metadata_lengths.name: build_versions_metadata_lengths
build_versions_metadata_lengths.value: ("build_versions"."title" IS NULL OR length(trim("build_versions"."title")) BETWEEN 2 AND 100) AND ("build_versions"."description" IS NULL OR length("build_versions"."description") <= 5000) AND ("build_versions"."youtube_url" IS NULL OR length("build_versions"."youtube_url") <= 2048)

content_image_references_one_target.name: content_image_references_one_target
content_image_references_one_target.value: ("content_image_references"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("content_image_references"."build_version_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1

season_phases_date_order.name: season_phases_date_order
season_phases_date_order.value: "season_phases"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "season_phases"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "season_phases"."ends_at" > "season_phases"."starts_at"
